title: Each type in winter with a razai
caption:
It's razai season, and every type has a very different relationship with theirs.

Some calculate exactly how long they can stay in it. Some build a fort with snacks and no exit plan. Some kick it off and eat oranges on the roof in half sleeves. And some make sure everyone else has a warm one first.

Tag the person who steals your razai.

Which razai personality are you?
